results.name: ParkEntryPoints
results.title: Park Entry Points
results.description:
This hosted feature layer contains a simplified point-based representation of California State Parks entry locations. Each point identifies a park access or entry location and may include associated attributes such as park unit name, street address, related links, and other reference information useful for mapping, navigation, planning, and public information products.

The layer is intended to support California State Parks web maps, applications, dashboards, and other GIS products that require a consistent statewide reference for park entry locations. It may be used for general orientation, visitor access mapping, operational planning, and integration with other California State Parks GIS datasets.

This dataset is maintained as an authoritative California State Parks GIS resource. Users should review the attribute information and source details before using the layer for project-specific analysis, field navigation, or public-facing products requiring site-level confirmation.

Data updated: May 6, 2026
Hosted by: California State Parks
Item type: Hosted Feature Layer
Recommended use: Statewide park access mapping, web maps, visitor information products, planning maps, dashboards, and reference applications.
results.snippet: Authoritative hosted feature layer representing California State Parks park entry point locations, including basic access, park unit, address, and related reference information. This layer supports public-facing maps, internal planning, visitor orientation, and statewide park access mapping.
